item.title: K-pop architect Lee Soo-man returns with double debut
item.description:
Korea Herald • Debut / new group
Lee Soo-man, founder of SM Entertainment and widely regarded as the architect of modern K-pop, is returning to the Korean music industry with the simultaneous debut of a boy group and a girl group under his new label, A2O Entertainment. The launch marks his first domestic music project since his three-year noncompete agreement with Hybe expired in February. item.title: And2ble to release 2nd EP later this month
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Boy group And2ble will return with its second EP “Sequence 2: Attraction” on Oct. 27, agency YH Entertainment announced Tuesday. The mini album follows its May debut set, “Sequence 1: Curiosity,” which captured the subtle shift of budding curiosity despite anxiety toward facing a new world. item.title: All’N returns with third single ‘Ding’
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
K-pop soloist All’N has released his third single “Ding,” continuing his violin-driven approach to K-pop while leaning further into electronic music. Released Friday, “Ding” arrives less than two months after his previous single, “Dream Higher.” The new track blends K-pop and dubstep with electric guitar, bass, synthesizers, rap and violin.
